```javascript
const notes = new Map();
let counter = 0;

function generateId() {
  counter += 1;
  return 'n' + counter;
}

export async function listTools() {
  return [
    {
      name: 'note_create',
      description: 'Create a new note with a title and body.',
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          title: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, description: 'Title of the note' },
          body: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, description: 'Body of the note' },
        },
        required: ['title', 'body'],
      },
    },
    {
      name: 'note_get',
      description: 'Retrieve a note by its ID.',
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          note_id: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, description: 'ID of the note' },
        },
        required: ['note_id'],
      },
    },
  ];
}

function textResult(text) {
  return { content: [{ type: 'text', text }] };
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  args = args || {};
  if (name === 'note_create') {
    const { title, body } = args;
    if (typeof title !== 'string' || title.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Invalid arguments: title must be a non-empty string');
    }
    if (typeof body !== 'string' || body.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Invalid arguments: body must be a non-empty string');
    }
    const id = generateId();
    notes.set(id, { id, title, body });
    return textResult(`Created note ${id}: ${title}`);
  }
  if (name === 'note_get') {
    const { note_id } = args;
    if (typeof note_id !== 'string' || note_id.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Invalid arguments: note_id must be a non-empty string');
    }
    const note = notes.get(note_id);
    if (!note) {
      throw new Error(`Note not found: ${note_id}`);
    }
    return textResult(`Title: ${note.title}\nBody: ${note.body}`);
  }
  throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
}
```
